# Crochetbykomiko Boutique
We are a premium handcrafted crochet business specializing in slow-fashion, artisan bags, baby apparel, and home decor. 

## Products
- Crochet Rose Bag: Handcrafted tote with 3D red rose design.
- Royal Baby Frock: Delicate white and beige baby cardigan.
- Sunflower Pot: Artisan home decor.

## Brand Values
Sustainable, handcrafted, slow-fashion, premium quality. Every piece is an investment in artistry, handcrafted with passion by Komal Kerur in India.
